description: Keyed rows carrying :_memo skip re-patching when their dep object is unchanged: data-render freezes at the last non-skipped render for untouched rows, updates for replaced rows, and survives keyed reorder
initialVDOM: dom.el('ul', 'list', {}, state.items.map((item) => dom.el('li', item.id, { _memo: item, 'data-key': item.id, 'data-render': String(state.gen) }, [dom.txt(item.label, item.id + '-t')])))

steps.description: Initial render stamps data-render=1 on all rows
Replace only row b's object; bump gen - rows a/c must SKIP (data-render stays 1), row b patches to gen 2
steps.newVDOM: dom.el('ul', 'list', {}, state.items.map((item) => dom.el('li', item.id, { _memo: item, 'data-key': item.id, 'data-render': String(state.gen) }, [dom.txt(item.label, item.id + '-t')])))

assertions.description: Row a skipped (stale stamp proves it)

steps.description: Reorder rows without changing objects; bump gen - order updates, every row still skips its patch
steps.newVDOM: dom.el('ul', 'list', {}, [state.items[2], state.items[0], state.items[1]].map((item) => dom.el('li', item.id, { _memo: item, 'data-key': item.id, 'data-render': String(state.gen) }, [dom.txt(item.label, item.id + '-t')])))

assertions.description: Row a still skipped across the move
Row b keeps its gen-2 stamp

steps.description: Remove row a - skipped rows unmount cleanly
steps.newVDOM: dom.el('ul', 'list', {}, [state.items[2], state.items[1]].map((item) => dom.el('li', item.id, { _memo: item, 'data-key': item.id, 'data-render': String(state.gen) }, [dom.txt(item.label, item.id + '-t')])))
